messages.author: e68a1208f312170f
messages.subject: using legend with scale_color_identity
parts:
Hi All --

I'm trying to get a legend to work with scale_color_identity. I'm failing, and I'm hoping I can be shown the error of my ways.

From the most relevant docs:
# To get a legend guide, you also need to supply labels, and specify
# guide = "legend"
qplot(1:4, 1:4, fill = colour, geom = "tile") +
  scale_fill_identity("trt", labels = letters[1:4], breaks = colour,
   guide = "legend")

Reproducible example (mostly lifted from the balloonplot docs):

# The data:
carnames <- c("BMW: High End, German",
              "Renault: Medium End, French",
              "Mercedes: High End, German",
              "Seat: Imaginary, Unknown Producer")
carcolors <- c("red","white","grey","green")
datavals <- round(rnorm(16, mean=100, sd=60),1)
data <- data.frame(Car=rep(carnames,4),
                   carColors=rep(carcolors, c(4,4,4,4) ),
                   Value=datavals,  stringsAsFactors=TRUE ) #stringsAsFactors setting specified because my default is FALSE
data$x=sample(1:nrow(data),nrow(data))

# The plots
# just lines
ggplot(data, aes(x=x, y=Value, color=carColors)) + geom_line()

# with assigned colors
ggplot(data, aes(x=x, y=Value, color=carColors)) + geom_line() + scale_color_identity()

# following the scale_fill_identity docs
ggplot(data, aes(x=x, y=Value, color=carColors)) + geom_line() + scale_color_identity("legTitle",labels = 1:nrow(data), breaks=carColors, guide = "legend")
# generates error: Error in is.vector(breaks) : object 'carColors' not found

# following the scale_fill_identity docs, but fully specifying the breaks data
ggplot(data, aes(x=x, y=Value, color=carColors)) + geom_line() + scale_color_identity("legTitle",labels = 1:nrow(data), breaks=data$carColors, guide = "legend") + opts(legend.position = 'left')

All ideas appreciated!

s

scale_color_identity("legTitle",limits = carcolors, guide = "legend")
